Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, sr As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.HasErrorBars = True: sr.HasErrorBars = False
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludePlusValues, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 0.5
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeMinusValues, xlErrorBarTypePercent, 10
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeStDev, 2
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeStError
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeCustom, 1, 2
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeNone, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlX, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: sr.ErrorBars.EndStyle = xlNoCap
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: sr.ErrorBars.Delete
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, -1
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, 7, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, 9, 1
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlBarClustered
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.ErrorBar xlX, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 22
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Axes(xlValue).MajorUnit = 2: sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 23
        ch.ChartType = xlBarClustered
        ch.Axes(xlValue).MajorUnit = 0.25: sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 24
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ch.Axes(xlValue).MajorUnit = 3: sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 25
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        ch.Axes(xlValue).MajorUnit = 3: sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 26
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        ws.Range("B2:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(100, 250, 700)): sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 27
        ch.ChartType = xlDoughnut
        sr.HasErrorBars = True
    Case 28
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.SeriesCollection(2).ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: s = ch.SeriesCollection(2).ErrorBars.Name & ";"
    Case 29
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludePlusValues, xlErrorBarTypePercent, 5
    Case 30
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: sr.ErrorBars.EndStyle = 7
    Case 31
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: s = TypeName(sr.ErrorBars.Parent) & ";"
    Case 32
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeCustom, ws.Range("C2:C4"), ws.Range("B2:B4")
    Case 33
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeCustom, Array(1, 2, 3), 1
    Case 34
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue
    Case 35
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.ErrorBar xlY, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: sr.ErrorBar xlX, xlErrorBarIncludePlusValues, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 2
    Case 36
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
        sr.ErrorBar xlX, xlErrorBarIncludeBoth, xlErrorBarTypeFixedValue, 1: sr.HasErrorBars = False
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sr.HasErrorBars
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sr.ErrorBars.EndStyle
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sr.ErrorBars.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 36
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
